units.source_text: 好像一下子没有什么事能让人担忧的了。

en.t: It seemed that all at once there was nothing left to worry about.

units.source_text: 他松了一口气，突然，脸内侧的脉搏重重地捶了起来，发烧似的热起来。

en.t: He breathed a sigh of relief, and suddenly the pulse inside his face began to pound heavily, growing hot as if with fever.

units.source_text: 于是，以前在意识中竭力不去考虑的那瓶烧酒，

en.t: Then the bottle of shochu, which he had been trying hard not to think about,

units.source_text: 犹如飘浮在暗夜里的一盏明灯，

en.t: like a bright lamp floating in the dark night,

units.source_text: 突然把他的全部精神集中到一点上来。

en.t: suddenly drew all his attention to a single point.

units.source_text: 什么都可以，只要能润润嗓子。

en.t: Anything would do, as long as it could moisten his throat.

units.source_text: 再在这样下去，身体里的血液都要死去了。

en.t: If this went on, even the blood in his body would die.

units.source_text: 于是，虽然明知撒下苦种，会后悔不已，

en.t: And so, although he knew perfectly well that sowing bitter seed would leave him full of regret,

units.source_text: 他拔了瓶塞，瓶口碰到牙齿，他对着瓶口就是一大口。

en.t: He pulled out the stopper, the mouth of the bottle touched his teeth, and he took a huge swallow straight from it.

units.source_text: 然而，舌头还是忠实的看门狗。

en.t: Yet the tongue was still a faithful watchdog.

units.source_text: 突如其来的闯入者弄得它狂躁起来。

en.t: The sudden intruder drove it into a frenzy.

units.source_text: 他呛了出来，像在伤口上搽双氧水。

en.t: He choked it out, as if hydrogen peroxide had been dabbed on a wound.

units.source_text: 但却还是没能战胜第三口的诱惑。

en.t: But even so, he could not overcome the temptation of a third mouthful.

units.source_text: 可真是意料之外的祝贺酒……

en.t: It was truly an unexpected celebratory drink...
